decisionsTitle: The Administrator controls the site's door: «Înscrieri publice deschise», «Locurile libere le dau doar eu», «Pe site acum» and the places alert
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03:** «cumva trebuie să pot controla mai bine» — after closing the public registration by setting the waiting list to «Fără listă de așteptare», which then also refused his own «Oferă-i un loc acum».

**Decision.** Five changes, none of which ever blocks a staff verb:

1. **«Înscrieri publice deschise»** (`events.public_registration_open`, on by default — every event keeps the door its dates give it). A real tick in the editor's «Perioada de înscriere», and the same tick beside «Locuri» on the registrations page (Administrator only, asked first, audited `event.public_registration_changed` with `via: "registrations"`, the row's `version` moved so an open editor is told; the Organizer reads the state). Unticked, inside an open window the public card and page draw `PAUSED` — «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.», no button — and the register page says so instead of the form; the server refuses the public form and its emailed link for another person (`PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_PAUSED`), off the caller's row and again under the event lock. Every staff door is untouched: the staff entry, the desk, «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Oferă-i un loc acum», «Mută pe lista oficială», «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», the invitations (an invitation's form is the invitation's door, §647). A registration already sent goes on: its address confirmation is not a new entry. Outside the window the dates speak, as before.

2. **«Locurile libere le dau doar eu»** (`events.free_places_by_offer_only`, off by default). A tick under «Locurile din lista de așteptare se alocă automat». Ticked, a registration from the **public** form never takes a free place: it joins the official waiting list in its order beside a free place, or is refused like a full race when the line takes nobody (a limit reached, or 0). It is one condition inside the one allocator's opening (`placeForNewcomer`, `newcomerJoinsLine`), on the entry's channel — `public` for the public form, its link for another person, a family's form and reservation, a verified runner's restart through it, and the address confirmation of a row the public form wrote; `staff` for every staff verb, an invitation and a late signature keeping the place it was given — never on `kind`. Every allocator call names its channel (the option is required, so no door can forget). The capacity formula is untouched: the switch only ever says «not for this entry» to a free place, so it cannot seat anybody past the capacity — overbooking is impossible by construction, and the locked transaction `tests/concurrency/capacity.test.ts` checks is the same one. A staff entry takes a free place as before while nobody waits; once somebody waits it queues behind them, as §615 and §872 already said («never ahead of anyone») — the free places are then given by «Trimite-i oferta» to whom the Administrator chooses. The public card never invites a direct registration while it is ticked: «Locurile se dau din lista de așteptare» and the waiting list's button beside free places; free places with a line that takes nobody is `PAUSED` with its own words («Locurile rămase le dau organizatorii: nu te poți înscrie direct pe site.»), never «s-au ocupat». The automatic offer (`waitlist_auto_offer`) is unchanged: on «Da», a free place still goes to the head of the line by itself, as an offer — the editor's «?» says to choose «Nu» to hand every place out by hand.

3. **«Oferă-i un loc acum» is never refused by the waiting list's limit.** The entry ends with the person offered, not waiting, so neither the door's check nor the allocator asks the limit — 0, «Fără listă de așteptare», included (`thenOffered`, carried only by `enterOnWaitlistByStaff` with `offerNow`, from the official list's add form and from a line of the internal list). The offer runs in the same transaction; refused (an unconfirmed supplementary place), it takes the whole entry back, so nobody is ever left waiting past the limit. **«Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» and «Mută pe lista oficială» keep honouring the limit** (§348): they leave the person waiting, which is exactly what the limit bounds.

4. **«Pe site acum»** — one line under «Locuri» on the registrations page, read off the public card's own predicate (`registrationCta`, through `public-now.ts#readPublicDoor` over `readPublicPlaces`), never a second copy of its rules: «Pe site acum: butonul «Înscrie-te» — primul venit ia un loc liber.», «Pe site acum: «Intră pe lista de așteptare» — X din Y locuri pe listă.», or «Pe site acum: înscrierile sunt închise — <de ce>» (the dates, the tick, the free places the organizers' alone with no line, the line full, no line, cancelled, over, not on this site), with «Schimbă în editor» to the fold that changes it (`#box-registration-window`, `#box-places-control`, `#box-registration`; a `<details>` opens on a fragment inside it). Read live, never from the public cache. An event with no capacity has no «Locuri»: the line and the tick stand alone.

5. **«Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri»** (`events.places_alert_at`, null — off — by default; 0 is «only when full») with its memory `events.places_alert_sent` (null, `LOW`, `FULL`). The Administrators and Superadministrators with an address are emailed through the outbox (`PLACES_ALERT`, RO and EN, the counts on the bold facts line, the button to the event's registrations) once when the free places drop to N or fewer and once when they reach 0; a drop straight to 0 sends the «full» one alone; re-armed only when the free places climb back above N, so a place freed and taken again near the end sends nothing more. Free is the capacity less the allocator's occupied count, the number «Locuri» says first. Checked in the transaction of every allocator write, under its lock — `allocateOrWaitlist`, `fillAvailableSpots` (every path that frees, adds or offers a place comes through it), a family's reservation, a send of invitations — never by an interval job; the memory column is written without moving the row's `version`. Switching the setting off forgets the last crossing.

**Refused.** Closing the site by setting the waiting list to 0 — what the owner did — because it also closed the line to the staff's own offers and said «Locurile s-au ocupat» to the public about places that were free; the limit stays a bound on the line, the door has its own tick. A toggle button for either switch (the owner, 2026-10-14: an on/off setting is a real tick box). A job that polls the places for the alert — it would wake the database for nothing (§334); the write that takes a place is the only moment it can cross. Making «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» also switch the automatic offer off — two settings, two meanings; the help says how they combine.
changelogLine: - **More control over registration from the site** — «Înscrieri publice deschise» stops the site's button and the public form at once (editor and beside «Locuri», staff verbs untouched); «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» sends every public entry to the waiting list; «Oferă-i un loc acum» no longer refused by the waiting list's limit; «Pe site acum» says what the public sees; «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri» emails the Administrators. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an internal event whose window is open and whose «Înscrieri publice deschise» is unticked, when a visitor opens its card, its page or its register page, then no registration button is drawn and the page says «Înscrierile pe site sunt oprite de organizatori.»; when the public form or its emailed link for another person is posted, then the server refuses it with `publicRegistrationPaused` — off the caller's row and again under the event lock — and writes nothing; and every staff entry, the desk, «Trimite-i oferta», «Dă-i un loc», «Oferă-i un loc acum» and an invitation still work. The tick is set in the editor's «Perioada de înscriere» and beside «Locuri» by an Administrator alone, audited (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» ticked and a free place, when a registration from the public form confirms its address, then it joins the waiting list in its order and takes no place — or, when the waiting list takes nobody (a limit reached, or 0), the form is refused like a full race and nothing is written — while a staff entry with nobody waiting still takes the free place; the condition is on the entry's channel, never on `kind`, and the capacity formula is unchanged; the public card shows the waiting list's door and never «Înscrie-te» (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event whose waiting list is full or has a limit of 0, when an Administrator presses «Oferă-i un loc acum» — from the official list's add form or from a line of the internal list — then the entry ends with the person offered a place (a counted free one, or the one supplementary place the dialog named) and is never refused by the waiting list's limit; an offer refused takes the whole entry back; «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» and «Mută pe lista oficială», which leave the person waiting, are still refused by the limit (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event chosen on the registrations list, when the page renders, then «Pe site acum» says, from the public card's own predicate, whether the site shows «Înscrie-te» (a free place for the first to come), the waiting list's door with the line's length and limit, or closed with its reason — the dates, the tick «Înscrieri publice deschise», the free places the organizers' alone with no line, the line full, no line — and links to the editor's fold that changes it (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given an event with «Anunță-mă când rămân N locuri» set, when an allocator write — public or staff — leaves N or fewer places free, then every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address is emailed `PLACES_ALERT` once, in the write's own transaction; when the places reach 0, once more; nothing more while they stay at or under N; again only after they climb back above N. Off, nobody is emailed (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the Administrator controls the site's door: public registration tick, free places by offer only, «Pe site acum», places alert
